title: Italy Installed 4.83 GW of Solar Capacity in First Nine Months of 2026
summary: Italy installed 4.83 GW of solar power capacity through 147,632 new projects between January and September 2026, according to an analysis by the industry association Italia Solare. Solar capacity additions brought the country’s cumulative solar capacity to 48.34 GW, with 2.31 million grid-connected projects.
